name: El Palau d'Anglesola (Spain)
description: Red field with a yellow stripe along the fly bearing three black wavy pales, charged towards the hoist with a white castle beneath a white Maltese cross.
history: Municipal flag of El Palau d'Anglesola; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: stripe along the fly bearing three black wavy pales
three wavy pales on the fly stripe
small Maltese cross above the castle
